name: chromancy-theming
description: One palette and font set for the GNOME desktop: libadwaita and GTK apps, the GNOME Shell menus, Qt and Flatpak apps, and app config files

scripts.test:gjs: for f in tests/gjs/*.gjs.js; do GSETTINGS_BACKEND=memory gjs -m "$f" || exit 1; done
scripts.check: pnpm run lint && pnpm test && pnpm run test:gjs
